# Measurement-evidence successor — concrete-byte review

2026-09-07. **CONCRETE MODEL BYTES ACCEPTED AND FROZEN.**
User accepts the positive seven-artifact packet and the four control ModelIdentity representations.
EVC-MODEL-BYTE PASS is limited to reproducibility, identity construction, registry delta and
historical preservation. Runtime implementation is now authorized under this RulesVersion only.

RulesVersion: `rules/campaign2-measurement-evidence/0.1-candidate`.
Positive-specimen ModelDigest:
`8dec83b33366ea13217db0005942f9e159ff2e36402c241231af5d5e1f04d22c`.

[Complete packet](campaign2-measurement-evidence-model/REVIEW_MANIFEST.json) contains seven
canonical artifacts and readable counterparts, the expanded 31-entry ordered semantic bundle,
exact profile tuple, four availability/permission model identities, structural deltas and
preservation hashes for 87 prior packet/allocation files.

The review constructor in `scripts/materialize-campaign2-measurement-evidence-model.mjs`
starts from declaration constructors, reuses the accepted probe declaration validation, adds
only allocated carriage declarations and commits through the existing identity functions.
It does not invoke a carriage factory, scheduler, ingress runtime or persistence adapter.
Stored frozen packet bytes are comparison evidence only, not construction inputs.
## Identity and registry changes

Content, parameters, ContentIdentity and ParameterIdentity remain byte-identical to probe .2.
Numeric/RNG versions and the probe ordered-input profile remain unchanged. RegistrySchemaVersion,
RegistryManifest/RegistryIdentity and RulesVersion change. ModelIdentity fields 1 and 6 differ.

Slot 0 adds six descriptors, the 336 definition and the 341 registration, and replaces exactly
one V04 singleton entry with its occurrence-map extension: nine added canonical set elements,
one removed old singleton element. LearningRoutes/TransitionRoutes and the singleton version
stay unchanged. Every other inherited registry entry is retained byte-for-byte. Slot 5 adds
eight roles with no removals. Slots 1..4 are byte-identical. No type-259 row is added.

The four variants change only the two existing probe booleans and produce distinct committed
registry/model identities. The review manifest lists all four full ModelIdentity representations.
Canonical set permutation preserves the positive commitment. Every artifact decodes/re-encodes
exactly through the isolated review schema registry.
## Evidence scope

The materializer reports 102 checks, including inherited-row preservation, exact slot changes,
profile rejection, four-model distinction, permutation parity and source-schedule comparisons.
It additionally rejects removal of every individual slot-0 and slot-5 element through exact
specimen validation. This validates the bounded review model, not a generic V07 runtime compiler.

| Packaging obligation | Current evidence and limit |
|---|---|
| EVC-PACK-A | Exact structural delta, preservation and missing-entry negatives pass. Runtime model admission remains separate. |
| EVC-PACK-B | Committed exact V04/V06/V07 structure and specimen comparison pass. Generic execution dispatch remains unimplemented. |
| EVC-PACK-C | Review tuple is exact; wrong profile values reject. Authoritative factory binding is not implemented. |
| EVC-PACK-D | Exact safe definition, producer and identity declarations are committed; runtime capabilities are not exercised. |
| EVC-PACK-E | Reused input compiler rejects generated carriage events as initial inputs; carriage pending-save closure remains unimplemented. |
| EVC-PACK-F | Topology is frozen as a contract; no generated carriage runtime runs yet. NOT PASSED. |
| EVC-PACK-G | Historical immutability remains the accepted requirement; no carriage archive restore exists yet. NOT PASSED. |
| EVC-PACK-H | Four variants, canonical parity, preservation and permutation checks pass. Separate fresh-process proof checks exact regeneration. |
| EVC-PACK-I | Unmodified input compiler and inherited content/domains are reused. Empty, single-probe and reordered multiple-probe manifests yield identical canonical source schedules/IDs/sequences/payloads and initial allocators under both models. This bounded corpus is not universal manifest coverage or authored-source successor integration. |

All nine obligations remain FROZEN; component evidence does not silently mark the full obligations
passed. EVC-A..P, ADAPT-9b, parent control 9, PHEN-ADAPT and Campaign 2 remain OPEN/NOT PASSED
as previously scoped. No positive cognitive-state or learning claim is made.

[Fresh-process proof](CAMPAIGN2_MEASUREMENT_EVIDENCE_REMATERIALIZATION_PROOF.json) records hashes
for all 15 generated files before deletion, reconstruction in a new process and verification in
another process. The deletion script resolves and verifies the exact packet directory and file
inventory before unlinking only those generated files. No recursive deletion is used.

The first sandboxed Vite invocation could not read its configuration through esbuild. The authorized
normal-access retry completed; this was a tooling access failure, not a changed model or control.
No production source changes or historical artifact replacements were needed.

Review requested: concrete positive ModelIdentity, four model variants, exact registry delta,
profile/bundle bindings and these explicitly limited materialization findings. Only after the
concrete-byte freeze may authoritative carriage implementation begin.

Acceptance 2026-09-07 supersedes the pending-review language above. PACK/EVC runtime controls
remain unpassed; four control ModelIdentity representations, not four full packet directories,
are frozen. Prior probe models retain their original semantics.
# Measurement-evidence carriage — runtime qualification review

2026-09-07. **RUNTIME QUALIFIED — USER VERDICT ACCEPTED.**
Accepted runtime: `measurement-evidence-carriage/0.1-candidate`, registration extension
`transition-admission-extension/0.7-candidate`, solely under frozen
`rules/campaign2-measurement-evidence/0.1-candidate`.
ModelDigest: `8dec83b33366ea13217db0005942f9e159ff2e36402c241231af5d5e1f04d22c`.
Canonical ModelIdentity bytes remain authoritative. EVC-MODEL-BYTE is accepted PASS.
## Implemented behavior

The data-only factory admits exactly the frozen positive model and its four committed boolean
variants. Production declaration construction reproduces the frozen positive ModelIdentity;
no stored packet is used as a construction input. It selects the unchanged probe ordered-input
profile and the new registry, trace and persistence behavior directly from the frozen RulesVersion.

The V07 registration is admitted alongside unchanged V04/V06 rows. Its new input/output
occurrence rules use the existing shared occurrence interpreter with the new committed schema
and role declarations. There is no second provenance or observation-identity system. Generic
V04/V06 decoding retains its prior schema set and semantics. The first V07 profile remains exact,
not an open registration language or a universal V04/V06 superset.

Actual permitted phase-120 diagnostic 203 production is validated at the fixed observer-side
adapter, then reported to shared ingress. Shared ingress discovers the committed consumer and
owns the allocated intake child. The probe owns only tracking. Suppression produces only private
profile padding; missing/duplicate matching consumers cannot be repaired with padding.

The detached semantic consumer receives exactly observation, safe unit and allocated occurrence.
It publishes one 337 containing the exact 203 and unit; no state/model/trace/REG resolver is an
operand. Shared completion verifies the execution-allocated identity and exact admitted source.
No persistent state family is read or written by intake; no learning-route mapping is added.
Six runtime advances and eight generated children are checked before commit for every probe
branch. Phase-120 trace closes both children under successor ownership; padding is not V07.

Restore validates historical 337, the exact corresponding source/child/trace chain, unit/observer/
version, occurrence rule, allocator bound and the accepted observation-to-carriage ordinal spacing.
It never recomputes historical measurement from current R0/D or permission. Save wire fields and
empty analytical/random/continuing-input metadata remain unchanged.
## Executed evidence

[Runtime tests](../../src/test/campaign2MeasurementRuntime.test.ts) contain 18 focused controls,
including parameterized branch cases and loops of rejected substitutions. The active-source
regression passed **86 files / 563 tests** before the last five focused additions; the final
18-test carriage run covers those additions. Type-checking, production build and reference-boundary
check pass. No reference implementation files were changed.

[Runtime continuation proof](CAMPAIGN2_MEASUREMENT_EVIDENCE_CONTINUATION_PROOF.json) creates a
post-carriage save in one process, restores it in another and compares complete canonical saves
after later authored adaptation. [Materialization proof](CAMPAIGN2_MEASUREMENT_EVIDENCE_REMATERIALIZATION_PROOF.json)
recreates all 15 frozen packet files in fresh processes and preserves 87 prior files. The permanent
allocation audit remains PASS with 197 checks. These proof scopes are distinct.
## Accepted EVC disposition and exact scope

User accepts EVC-A..P and EVC-PACK-A..I PASS; EVC-MODEL-BYTE remains PASS.
EVC-B is PASS iff B1 (actual generic REG/probe/validation/shared V07/intake witness)
and B2 (altered anchor excluded by the frozen public model) both pass. This is not
a frozen public model run with different R0 declarations. EVC-E covers only the accepted
diagnostic-present domain. PACK-B covers only the frozen first production model, not an
arbitrary V07 language. PACK-I rests on exact implementation/profile reuse and bounded
witnesses, not enumeration of every possible manifest.

| Vector | Executed evidence / preservation basis |
|---|---|
| EVC-A | Same model, observation/337 identities and support topology; initial D=0 versus D=1 yields exact measurement 5 versus 51/10 and different 337 content. X/E/L remain identical. |
| EVC-B | **Component witness plus public exclusion.** Governed REG anchor 50/D=1 versus anchor 51/D=0 feeds actual probe execution; exact 203 and V07-produced 337 are identical. The changed anchor is rejected by the frozen public model. This does not claim two public models with the same ModelIdentity or a public R0 override. |
| EVC-C | All four available/permitted models execute; suppression produces no 337, all consume six/eight budget, and later authored-source EVID sentinel records/identities are equal. |
| EVC-D | Other-observer substitution rejects at intake; ownership comes from 336/203 ObserverId. SubjectId remains metadata and no CharacterId owner is derived. |
| EVC-E | Wrong observer/channel/producer version, precision, reference surface and occurrence namespace reject. Exact frozen-model comparison closes producer/schema configuration. Present-only Point domain delegates to the accepted diagnostic validator, including empty tokens/references and exact endpoints. |
| EVC-F | Runtime consumer is a detached three-operand function, with no state/index/resolver/model/trace handle. Reference injection and invented output content fail admission/completion. Existing exact output schema forbids added hidden fields. |
| EVC-G | 51/10 stays canonical exact rational inside byte-preserved 203. Altered observation, unit or transformation version and duplicated observation-as-output identity reject and roll back. |
| EVC-H | Later authored adaptation changes current D; historical 337 survives byte-identically through restore. Altered historical unit rejects. Wrong model is excluded by existing expected-ModelIdentity save validation. |
| EVC-I | Full prior probe regressions pass; old probe .2 emits no 337 and rejects the successor registry. Successor paired X/E/L remain identical. Frozen packets reproduce unchanged. |
| EVC-J | State is byte-identical across every probe/intake instant, including scalar-pair initial states. Consumer has no read/write operands or state patch. ORD-001 and cognitive update semantics remain unselected. |
| EVC-K | Missing/duplicate/altered child list, wrong phase/parent and changed payload reject at shared generative binding. Unassociated initial carriage input rejects. Existing shared capability consumption/liveness guards remain the same for V07. |
| EVC-L | 336/channel equality is enforced by exact compiled model; output unit must match 336. Wrong unit rejects. No REG key, scale, truth handle or duplicate observation identity is introduced. |
| EVC-M | All four branches have six ordinal advances/eight generated children, nine events including source, and identical subsequent sentinel identities. Private padding has no evidence output. Shared child mutations reject. |
| EVC-N | Injected intake failure after allocation and real/padded trace failures roll back state, allocators, queue, output, trace and clock. Restore before/after intake continues exactly; separate-process post-carriage continuation also passes. |
| EVC-O | Frozen-byte production identity equality; wrong RulesVersion, missing V07 row/337 role and wrong registration version reject. Shared occurrence extraction uses committed rules/roles. Allocation and prior-byte preservation remain separately audited. |
| EVC-P | Only measurement-carriage divergence is claimed. No responding cognitive update is implemented; ADAPT-9b and all parent campaign verdicts remain open. |

B's independent hidden-cause variation is a generic-component witness, as allowed by the accepted
seam's §1, not a widened public specimen. The component uses the actual REG provider, actual probe
producer, production input validation, shared V07 ingress/allocation/completion and the actual
semantic intake. No substitute cognitive consumer or fake public model is used.
## PACK disposition for review

| Obligation | Evidence / limit |
|---|---|
| PACK-A | Exact frozen registry construction and byte parity; slots 1..4 preserved; eight new roles, no union additions. |
| PACK-B | Bounded production compiler and shared runtime execute V04/V06/V07 together; wrong/missing V07 declarations reject. No claim of a broader generic model language. |
| PACK-C | Factory dispatch is fixed by RulesVersion, exact model fields and immutable profile bindings; old RulesVersion plus successor data rejects. No public adapter selector. |
| PACK-D | Safe 336/channel/producer closure and matching identity rules execute; mutation controls reject observer/channel/unit/role/version substitutions. |
| PACK-E | Existing original-input compiler reused unchanged; both generated carriage event kinds reject as initial inputs. Existing pending-source reconstruction remains shared. |
| PACK-F | Actual real/padding ownership, ordering and six/eight closure execute in all branches; late real/padded failure rolls back counters and queue. |
| PACK-G | Restore after later D change retains historical evidence; forged historical output rejects. |
| PACK-H | Four model representations remain frozen, exact identity and canonical reproduction pass; metadata disposition changes alone reflect the accepted freeze. |
| PACK-I | Same unmodified input compiler and same inherited content/domain dependencies; empty/single/reordered probe materialization corpus plus actual authored/probe continuation and common-sentinel controls. No empirical enumeration of the infinite manifest domain is claimed. Source scheduling is independent of ModelIdentity by the shared compiler's construction. |
## Retained defects and corrections

The first focused runtime pass produced correct intake/padding but restore omitted the carriage
configuration when reconstructing the runtime, selecting the old probe trace binding. Restore now
passes the compiled carriage configuration explicitly; all four branch save/restore controls pass.
This was an implementation defect, not a contract or frozen-byte change.

The first full parallel test run had four existing five-second timeouts under contention. The
focused probe run passed; the complete suite then passed with two workers and unchanged timeout
settings. The initial sandboxed Vite invocation encountered the known esbuild config-access limit;
normal-access execution succeeded. These environment failures are not counted as semantic passes.
## Qualification disposition and next decision

The bounded runtime qualification and explicit **EVC-B component/public-exclusion scope**
are accepted. No semantic redesign, numeric allocation or model-byte change accompanies this
verdict. The [next target proposal](CAMPAIGN2_RESPONDING_COGNITION_TARGET_REVIEW.md) requests
selection of a responding cognitive mechanism; carriage does not select one or claim ADAPT-9b.

ADAPT-9b, parent control 9, PHEN-ADAPT and Campaign 2 remain OPEN. Belief, memory, appraisal,
reward, persistent evidence stores, generic measurement formats, CharacterId-owned intake and
unit conversion remain deferred.
